question: Which two gases are having the highest percentage of the earth's atmosphere?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nitrogen and Oxygen.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nitrogen and Oxygen are having the highest percentage of the Earth's atmosphere.**
 
• The most abundant naturally occurring gas is Nitrogen
